  • Do not use if previously opened or if pouch damaged.
  • Check the syringe for visual manufacturing defect/crack before using, to avoid loss of medication
  • Reuse of product may lead to cross contamination/injection
  • Before use rotate the needle clockwise to ensure proper fitment on the barrel nozzle.
  • Pull the needle cap straight off to avoid damaging needle point.
  • Avoid piercing the needle through the  wall in hand plastic container, it may result in needle blockage.
  • Do not inject a medicament in the blood vessels which is not to be injected intravenously, Aspirate to confirm that needle is not in a blood vessle Prior to injection medicament
  • Please Discard in a sharps container
  • Store in clean, Dry and insect free place.
  • Avoid Exposure to excessive heat
  • Avoid exposure to acidic/corrosive fumes to avoid corrosion /Rust
